Additionally, students must employ conflict resolution and people skills to navigate challenging situations and people effectively. By upholding these expectations, students can foster a professional work environment that promotes collaboration, trust, and productivity.

	- Curriculum vitae is a short written summary of a person's career, qualifications, and education.

turns.speaker: model_b
turns.content: In applying for job positions, it is essential to have the appropriate credentials that truthfully reflect your skills and qualifications. Students are expected to curate their credentials carefully, ensuring that their skills and qualifications are aligned with the job position they are applying for. Credentials such as diplomas, certificates and training experiences must be verifiable and truthful. One powerful tool in showcasing these credentials effectively is the curriculum vitae (CV). The CV is a short, written summary of a person's career, qualifications, and education. It is crucial to update the CV regularly and ensure its accuracy, as it effectively communicates your skills, experience and education background when applying for job opportunities. By ensuring that their credentials and CVs are truthful and tailored to the job position, students can establish their credibility and enhance their chances of being hired.

turns.content: Write a paragraph of behavioral expectations during orientation and introduction to management processes.

turns.speaker: model_b
turns.content: In orientation and introduction to management processes, students are expected to be engaged, proactive and to demonstrate a positive attitude towards learning. Orientation provides an opportunity for students to learn about the company's core values, mission, and vision, and its management processes. It also allows them to internalize the company's culture and build a sense of belongingness. In this process, students should be attentive, ask relevant questions, and seek clarification when unsure. They should also be open-minded and receptive to feedback, criticisms, and different viewpoints. It's crucial to respect the hierarchy of the workplace, so when dealing with managers, students must be professional and courteous in their communication and actions. Lastly, students should understand that orientation and introduction to management processes is an essential part of their learning and growth, so it's important to take it seriously and put the skills and knowledge acquired to use. By demonstrating these expectations, students can lay a foundation of success and establish a positive impression within the company.

Students must actively engage in their work and record their progress accurately, detailing the skills they've acquired, their achievements, and the challenges they've encountered. Finally, students are expected to respect the work environment and respect the properties, and equipment belonging to the company. By following these expectations, students can maximize their learning experience and demonstrate their professionalism in the work environment.
